items.title: 紐時：黃仁勳離職引發「國安代罪羔羊」聯想 讓亞裔美國人感到恐懼
items.title_en: NYT: Jensen Huang’s Resignation Triggers ‘National‑Security Scapegoat’ Talk, Leaving Asian Americans Fearful
paras: 《紐約時報》近日以「黃仁勳落馬 亞裔美國人失去一位明星，恐懼隨之而來」為題發布報導，指出輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳的迅速垮台，對美國科技業的台裔與華裔社群帶來深層失望與恐懼。
報導稱，黃仁勳長期以來被視為打破「竹子天花板」(bamboo ceiling)的象徵——即突破職場上認為亞裔膽小順從、缺乏大膽決策力的歧視偏見。他的離職不僅震撼產業界，更引發亞裔社群對加劇種族偏見與過度審查的擔憂。
對許多亞裔從業者而言，黃仁勳曾是不可戰勝的榜樣。Hyphen Capital 管理合夥人、矽谷科技老將Dave Lu形容，黃仁勳展現出極強的氣勢與啟發性，大家曾以為他無懈可擊、宛如超級英雄。然而在婚外情與相關風波曝光後，Lu透露他接獲大量亞裔高階主管的訊息，普遍感到極度失落與沮喪。
哥倫比亞大學教授Jennifer Lee則指出，黃仁勳代表了打破竹子天花板的理想領導者：有遠見、具創新力且富有魅力。
然而，這場風波也伴隨著對國家安全與間諜疑慮的討論，使亞裔族群面臨被污名化的風險。華裔非營利組織「百人會」北加州地區主任Buck Gee坦言，黃仁勳展現了不良判斷力，若自己身為輝達董事會成員也會選擇將其開除。但他同時引述數據指出，雖然亞裔占矽谷勞動力近半，但高階主管中僅佔約 25%，凸顯出高層代表性不足的既有困境。
更令社群不安的是醜聞可能引發的連鎖反應。《黃種人》一書作者、台裔法學家Frank Wu警告，華裔美國人長期面臨被懷疑為叛徒、商業機密竊賊或外國代理人的偏見，「我們最不需要的就是再有人捲入這類問題」。
亞裔美國人促進正義協會主席John C. Yang強調，亞裔與科技界確實極度擔心自己再次成為國安風險事件下的代罪羔羊。報導認為，黃仁勳的下台不僅是一位象徵性領袖的跌落，也揭示了亞裔在美科技高層路上的脆弱與嚴峻挑戰。
paras_en: The New York Times recently ran a story titled “Jensen Huang’s Fall Leaves Asian Americans Without a Star, Fear Follows,” noting that the rapid downfall of former NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang has dealt a deep blow of disappointment and fear to the Taiwanese‑ and Chinese‑heritage communities in America’s tech sector.

The report says Huang has long been seen as a symbol for breaking the “bamboo ceiling”—the discriminatory stereotype that Asian workers are timid, compliant, and lack bold decision‑making. His departure not only shocked the industry but also sparked Asian‑American concerns about escalating racial bias and heightened scrutiny.

For many Asian professionals, Huang was an invincible role model. Dave Lu, managing partner at Hyphen Capital and a Silicon Valley veteran, described Huang as possessing tremendous presence and inspiration, someone people thought was unbeatable, like a superhero. After the affair and related scandal broke, Lu said he received a flood of messages from senior Asian executives who felt profoundly disappointed and disheartened.
Columbia University professor Jennifer Lee pointed out that Huang embodied the ideal leader who shatters the bamboo ceiling: visionary, innovative, and charismatic.

However, the controversy also brought discussions of national‑security and espionage concerns, putting the Asian community at risk of stigmatization. Buck Gee, director of the Northern California chapter of the Chinese‑American nonprofit “Bai Ren Hui,” admitted that Huang displayed poor judgment and that, had he been a board member at NVIDIA, he would have voted to fire him. He also cited data showing that although Asians make up nearly half of Silicon Valley’s workforce, they hold only about 25% of senior‑executive positions, highlighting the persistent lack of representation at the top.

What unsettles the community further is the potential chain reaction from the scandal. Frank Wu, a Taiwanese‑American legal scholar and author of “The Yellow Race,” warned that Chinese‑American Americans have long faced stereotypes of being traitors, corporate‑secret thieves, or foreign agents, and “the last thing we need is for anyone else to get caught up in that kind of trouble.”

John C. Yang, chair of the Asian American Justice Association, emphasized that Asian Americans in tech are extremely worried about becoming scapegoats again in national‑security incidents. The report concludes that Huang’s ouster is not only the fall of a symbolic leader but also a revelation of the fragility and severe challenges Asian professionals face on the path to senior tech leadership in the United States.

items.title: 中國大模型告別刷分內卷！阿里、騰訊、百度一周內集體發力  推理成本成新戰場
items.title_en: China's Large Models Say Goodbye to Score-Chasing Competition! Alibaba, Tencent, Baidu All Push Forward Within a Week, Inference Cost Becomes New Battlefield
paras: 上周一(9日)，GameFeel Bench評測截圖在開發者圈傳開，代號hawk的Qwen4-Flash內測接口獲49.9分，超越Claude Opus 5.5的47.2分；Qwen4-27B以44.6分逼近Sonnet 5.5的45分。該榜單在GitHub僅12星標，7項指標中4項依賴人工主觀打分，聚焦遊戲創造力，非通用推理，不足以構成「全面反超」鐵證。
阿里巴巴藉此在Qwen4發布前在輿論上先發制人，但中國大模型競爭正告別「刷榜時代」，轉向成本較量：相同任務Qwen4-Flash單次成本約0.4美元，Claude Opus 5.5高達2.6美元；Qwen4-27B更壓至0.16美元，6倍價差才是企業財報上的硬實力。
截至上周五(13日)，阿里未公布Qwen4參數量、權重開放及每token單價，其商業意圖清晰：以包月訂閱剝離按量計費焦慮。
上周三(11日)上線的Qwen4-Max預覽版僅走Token Plan通道，兼容OpenAI與Anthropic協議，遷移阻力僅改請求地址。配合限時1折、月費3美元起定價，直指誘導開發者遷移工作流。畢竟榜單會過期，工作流一旦遷入便難搬走。
百度11月5日開源文心5.5 Flash Base，並於上周三上架Preview版，確定25日開放權重；騰訊混元11月4日發布Hy4，高調宣稱躋身最強開源模型；短短7天，大廠不約而同將推理邊際成本打下來，鋪開低門檻部署通道。
這種白熱化競速對終端使用者是重大利好，卻對技術決策者提出新難題。過去選型只需比綜合總分，如今工程落地必須同時權衡任務完成率、單次運行成本、系統部署方式及版本迭代速度。實戰中，可抽取20個真實業務樣例實測，記錄3次重試內的最終成功率，再以單次平均調用成本除以該成功率，得出「每個成功任務的綜合成本」。此指標同時懲罰「回答不準確」與「調用太昂貴」，比任何商業榜單更穩健。
12顆星評比顯示輿論價值已兌現，但開發者需耐心等待正式版開源權重、透明參數規模及獨立第三方復測報告。這一輪大模型競爭的真正勝負關鍵，不在於49.9分對47.2分的紙面微弱領先，而在於誰能率先將「每個成功任務的成本」確立為全行業默認交付口徑。交出經得起拷問的硬數字，才能擺脫榜單內卷，贏得下一階段商業終局。
paras_en: Last Monday (the 9th), a GameFeel Bench evaluation screenshot spread among developers, showing the internal test interface codenamed "hawk" for Qwen4-Flash scoring 49.9 points, surpassing Claude Opus 5.5's 47.2 points; Qwen4-27B scored 44.6 points, closing in on Sonnet 5.5's 45 points. The leaderboard, which has only 12 stars on GitHub, relies on human subjective scoring for four of its seven metrics, focuses on game creativity rather than general reasoning, and therefore cannot serve as conclusive proof of a "comprehensive overtaking".

Alibaba used this moment to pre‑empt public opinion before the official Qwen4 launch, but the Chinese large‑model race is moving away from the "ranking‑chasing era" toward cost competition: for the same task, a single run of Qwen4‑Flash costs about $0.4, while Claude Opus 5.5 costs as much as $2.6; Qwen4‑27B is even lower at $0.16, a six‑fold price gap that translates into hard financial strength for enterprises.

As of last Friday (the 13th), Alibaba had not disclosed Qwen4's parameter count, weight openness, or per‑token price, but its commercial intent is clear: to shift from pay‑per‑use anxiety to a subscription‑only model.

The Qwen4‑Max preview released last Wednesday (the 11th) is available only through the Token Plan channel, compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, requiring only a change of request endpoint for migration. Coupled with a limited‑time 10% price and a starting monthly fee of $3, it aims to lure developers to move their workflows, since rankings will become obsolete and migrated workflows are hard to move back.

Baidu open‑sourced Wenxin 5.5 Flash Base on November 5 and launched a preview version last Wednesday, confirming weight release on the 25th; Tencent released Hy4 on November 4, boldly claiming it as the strongest open‑source model. Within just seven days, the tech giants have simultaneously driven down marginal inference costs, opening low‑threshold deployment channels.

This intense race is a major boon for end users but poses new challenges for technical decision‑makers. Previously, model selection was based on an overall score; now engineers must balance task success rate, per‑run cost, deployment method, and version‑update speed. In practice, one can test 20 real‑world business cases, record the final success rate within three retries, and divide the average per‑call cost by that success rate to obtain a "comprehensive cost per successful task". This metric penalizes both inaccurate answers and expensive calls, making it more robust than any commercial leaderboard.

A 12‑star rating shows that public value has been realized, yet developers must patiently await the official open‑source weights, transparent parameter specifications, and independent third‑party verification reports. The real decisive factor in this round of large‑model competition is not the marginal paper lead of 49.9 over 47.2, but who can first establish "cost per successful task" as the industry‑wide delivery standard. Delivering hard numbers that withstand scrutiny will break the ranking‑chasing cycle and win the next stage of commercial outcomes.

items.title: 中化生前三季EPS 2.01元轉盈 持續深化原料藥與CDMO業務
items.title_en: China Chemical Bio Q1‑Q3 EPS Turns Positive to NT$2.01, Continues Deepening Specialty API and CDMO Business
paras: 中化生(1762-TW)公告財報，累計今年前三季稅後純益1.11億元，每股純益2.01元，較去年同期轉盈。中化生指出，將持續深化原料藥(Specialty API)及CDMO業務。
中化生第三季營收2.18億元，季減28.58%，年增41.11%；毛利率22.49%，季減15.42個百分點，較去年同移轉正；營益率-10.84%，較第二季轉負，營業虧損較去年同期縮小；稅後虧損2103.9萬元，較第二季轉虧，不過虧損較去年同期收斂，每股虧損0.38元。
中化生累計今年前三季營收8.84億元，年增27.9%；毛利率35.65%，年增24.01個百分點；營益率35.65%，較去年同期轉正；稅後純益1.11億元，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益2.01元。
中石化指出，過去1年積極調整產品組合、提升製造效率，聚焦具備技術門檻與市場競爭力產品，加快特色原料藥商業化進程。同時，透過與BioDuro成立合資公司，推進歐洲大型藥廠的新藥CDMO專案。
展望明年，中化生表示，隨著特色原料藥新品逐步商業化，並深化國際CDMO合作，將加速擴大高附加價值業務營收貢獻，目標明年營收成長雙位數。
paras_en: China Chemical Bio (1762‑TW) announced its financial results, reporting a cumulative net profit after tax of NT$111 million for the first three quarters of this year, equating to earnings per share of NT$2.01, a turnaround from a loss in the same period last year. The company said it will continue to deepen its specialty API and CDMO businesses.

In the third quarter, China Chemical Bio posted revenue of NT$218 million, down 28.58% quarter‑over‑quarter but up 41.11% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 22.49%, a decline of 15.42 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter, turning positive compared with the same quarter last year; operating margin was –10.84%, shifting negative from the second quarter, while operating loss narrowed versus the same quarter last year; after‑tax loss was NT$21.039 million, a loss compared with the second quarter, but the loss narrowed relative to last year, amounting to a loss per share of NT$0.38.

Cumulatively for the first three quarters, revenue reached NT$884 million, a 27.9% increase year‑over‑year; gross margin was 35.65%, up 24.01 percentage points year‑over‑year; operating margin was 35.65%, turning positive versus the same period last year; net profit after tax was NT$111 million, a swing to profit from last year, with earnings per share of NT$2.01.

Sinopec noted that over the past year it has actively adjusted its product mix and improved manufacturing efficiency, focusing on products with technical barriers and market competitiveness, and accelerating the commercialization of specialty APIs. At the same time, through a joint venture with BioDuro, it is advancing new‑drug CDMO projects for large European pharmaceutical companies.

Looking ahead to next year, China Chemical Bio said that as new specialty API products are gradually commercialized and international CDMO collaborations are deepened, it will accelerate the growth of high‑value‑added business revenue, targeting double‑digit revenue growth next year.

items.title: 上市櫃超過150檔個股跌停 法人：市場關注輝達AI循環融資發展
items.title_en: Over 150 Listed Stocks Hit Limit Down; Institutions Watch Nvidia AI Cycle Financing Development
paras: 台股今(16)日盤中越走越低，加權指數跌點一度超過2200點，跌幅超過4.5%，櫃買指數跌幅更超過6%，合計上市櫃多達150檔亮跌停燈，市場氣氛延續上周五美股黑色星期五的恐慌拋售。
台積電今日盤中重挫達4%，造成跌點約830點，主要因外資沿路減碼，後續先觀察美國 ADR 走勢，而目前市場聚焦11月17日輝達公布財報，此為首場沒有黃仁勳的法說，統一投顧分析，將由代理執行長兼財務長柯蕾絲(Colette Kress)主持，儘管市場預期營收上看 1090 億美元、年增約 90%，但投資人聚焦核心已轉向黃仁勳離職後的領導真空、高達數千億美元的「AI 循環融資」與信用擔保是否收縮。
高市值個股有南亞(1303-TW)、台光電(2383-TW)、欣興(3037-TW)、奇鋐(3017-TW)、創意(3443-TW)、智邦(2345-TW)和大立光(3008-TW)、南電(8046-TW)、景碩(3189-TW)、台燿(6274-TW)和台玻(1802-TW)等均跌停。
元大投顧認為，日前大盤年線發揮超級抵抗，並出現大 V 型反彈，惟走法太過凌厲，幾乎未經過整理，籌碼不穩定，預期指數接下來將會在年線39212點與季線46165點間區間來回。
同時還需留意，將有 AI 獨角獸 Anthropic 掛牌定價。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks fell increasingly today (the 16th), with the weighted index dropping over 2,200 points at one point and falling more than 4.5%, while the OTC index slipped over 6%. A total of more than 150 listed stocks lit up the limit‑down signal, and market sentiment continued the panic sell‑off that followed last Friday’s Black Friday in the U.S. markets.

TSMC plunged about 4% intraday, wiping roughly 830 points, mainly because foreign investors trimmed positions and then watched the U.S. ADR trend. The market is now focused on Nvidia’s earnings release on November 17, the first without Jensen Huang. Unified Investment & Securities analysis says the briefing will be led by acting CEO and CFO Colette Kress. Although revenue is expected to reach $109 billion, up about 90% year‑over‑year, investors’ attention has shifted to the leadership vacuum after Huang’s departure, the multi‑hundred‑billion‑dollar ‘AI cycle financing’ and whether credit guarantees will tighten.

High‑market‑cap stocks such as Nanya (1303‑TW), Taiwan Optoelectronics (2383‑TW), Unimicron (3037‑TW), Qihong (3017‑TW), Creative (3443‑TW), Chipbond (2345‑TW), Largan Precision (3008‑TW), Nan Dian (8046‑TW), Jing Shuo (3189‑TW), Tai Yao (6274‑TW) and Taiwan Glass (1802‑TW) all hit limit‑down.

Yuanta Investment & Securities believes the market index recently showed strong resistance at the yearly line and produced a big V‑shaped rebound, but the move was too sharp, with almost no consolidation and unstable capital, expecting the index to oscillate between the yearly line at 39,212 points and the quarterly line at 46,165 points.
Also need to watch the upcoming listing price of AI unicorn Anthropic.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉光通訊遍地慘綠超過10檔亮燈跌停 台股仍待消化輝達利空
items.title_en: Focus Stocks: Optical Communication Stocks Plummet Over 10 Tickers Hit Limit Down, Taiwan Market Still Digesting Nvidia Bad News
paras: 台股今(16)日受美國科技股賣壓沉重，主要權值AI概念股回檔拖累大盤，市場解讀，台股為仍待消化輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳，個人去職大利空，加上台幣重貶接近33元，今日盤中一度重挫超過2,200點，盤面上高價科技股、AI相關指標全面走跌。包括光通訊龍頭股聯亞(3081-TW)也難倖免於難，今開低走低，亮燈跌破2,000元大關，其他光通訊供應鏈更是一片慘綠，包括輝達背板股的波若威(3163-TW)超過10檔一度觸及跌停。
台股今日開低走低，其中網通設備、光通訊族群遭遇狙擊強烈賣壓，類股大跌超過8.5%，光通訊族群中近年漲幅較大的CPO概念股，今日也承受賣壓遭下殺。
包括聯亞、光聖(6442-TW)、波若威、前鼎(4908-TW)、上詮(3363-TW)、華星光(4979-TW)、光環(3234-TW)、眾達-KY(4977-TW)、統新(6426-TW)、環宇-KY(4991-TW)、IET-KY(4971-TW)也超過10檔以上盤中紛紛重挫觸及跌停價。
其他包括聯鈞、東典光電跌幅也超過8.5%以上。
法人表示，光通訊今(2026)年漲幅過大，這波下殺顯示短線獲利盤與融資維持率壓力大舉出籠，導致多頭資金出現恐慌性撤離，建議投資人先觀察大盤氣氛與法人賣超是否收斂。
法人指出，投資人可靜待高融資個股完成融資斷頭與籌碼沉澱，先觀察大盤鈞線能否守穩，作為後續進場布局的參考依據。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market fell heavily today (the 16th) under pressure from US tech stocks, with major AI‑related index stocks pulling the market down. The market interprets this as Taiwan still needing to absorb the negative impact of Nvidia (NVDA‑US) former CEO Jensen Huang's personal departure, compounded by the New Taiwan dollar weakening to near NT$33. At one point the index plunged more than 2,200 points intraday, and high‑priced tech and AI‑related indicators all fell. Even the optical‑communication leader Lian Ya (3081‑TW) could not escape, opening lower and sliding below the NT$2,000 mark, while other optical‑communication suppliers were drenched in red, with more than ten stocks, including Nvidia back‑plane supplier Bo Ruo Wei (3163‑TW), briefly hitting their daily limit down.

The market opened lower and continued to fall, with networking equipment and optical‑communication groups hit by strong selling pressure, dragging the sector down more than 8.5%. Within the optical‑communication group, CPO‑related stocks that have surged in recent years also faced heavy selling today.

Companies such as Lian Ya, Guang Sheng (6442‑TW), Bo Ruo Wei, Qian Ding (4908‑TW), Shang Quan (3363‑TW), Hua Xing Guang (4979‑TW), Guang Huan (3234‑TW), Zhong Da‑KY (4977‑TW), Tong Xin (6426‑TW), Huan Yu‑KY (4991‑TW) and IET‑KY (4971‑TW) all saw more than ten stocks each plunge sharply and hit their limit‑down prices during the session.
Other stocks including Lian Jun and Dong Dian Optoelectronics also fell by more than 8.5%.

Institutional investors said that optical‑communication stocks have risen excessively this year (2026), and this wave of selling shows short‑term profit‑taking and high margin‑maintenance pressure forcing a panic exit of bullish capital. They advise investors to first watch the overall market sentiment and whether institutional net‑selling is easing.

Institutions also noted that investors can wait for highly‑leveraged stocks to complete margin calls and for share‑holding consolidation, while monitoring whether the market’s key support line holds, using that as a reference for future entry strategies.

items.title: 熙特爾與美國GE Vernova、韓國SK On簽署MOU 瞄準AI基建商機
items.title_en: Xiteler Signs MOU with US GE Vernova and South Korea SK On to Target AI Infrastructure Opportunities
paras: 熙特爾(7740-TW)今(16)日宣布，與美國能源設備大廠GE Vernova、韓國SK集團旗下電池製造商SK On簽署合作備忘錄(MOU)，建立台美韓戰略合作關係，三方將結合電力轉換技術、先進電池技術與大型儲能系統整合製造能力，共同布局國際能源市場，瞄準全球AI電力基礎建設商機。
熙特爾指出，此次合作將結合三方各自優勢，GE Vernova提供高功率電力轉換設備(PCS)，可望簡化系統配置、減少能源損耗並降低建置成本，提升大型儲能系統的運作效率與經濟效益；SK On提供磷酸鐵鋰(LFP)電芯與模組，藉由長循環壽命與電池技術，滿足大型儲能系統對長期可靠性的需求。
而熙特爾旗下辰熙精密(AUROSI)則負責在地化整合製造，將美韓兩大國際企業的核心技術，轉化為完整儲能解決方案。
熙特爾指出，隨著美國、日本等主要持續強化資安與供應鏈韌性需求，非紅供應鏈的重要性的提升。此次三方攜手結合優勢，強化供應鏈競爭力，並以台灣為合作起點，進一步拓展至日本、美國與加拿大等市場。
董事長林聖澤表示，隨著AI資料中心對穩定供電與能源韌性的要求提高，跨國技術合作將成為掌握市場商機的重要關鍵。此次三方攜手，整合各自在能源領域的核心優勢，有望發揮一加一加一大於三的綜效。
paras_en: Xiteler (7740‑TW) announced today (the 16th) that it has signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with US energy‑equipment giant GE Vernova and South Korean battery maker SK On, a subsidiary of the SK Group, establishing a Taiwan‑US‑Korea strategic partnership. The three parties will combine power‑conversion technology, advanced battery technology and large‑scale energy‑storage system integration capabilities to jointly pursue the international energy market and target global AI power‑infrastructure opportunities.

Xiteler said the cooperation will leverage each partner’s strengths: GE Vernova will provide high‑power power‑conversion equipment (PCS), which is expected to simplify system configuration, reduce energy loss and lower construction costs, thereby improving the operational efficiency and economic benefits of large‑scale storage systems; SK On will supply lithium‑iron‑phosphate (LFP) cells and modules, whose long cycle life and battery technology meet the long‑term reliability needs of large‑scale storage systems.

Xiteler’s subsidiary Chenxi Precision (AUROSI) will handle localized integration and manufacturing, turning the core technologies of the two major international firms into complete energy‑storage solutions.

Xiteler noted that as the United States, Japan and other major economies continue to strengthen cybersecurity and supply‑chain resilience requirements, the importance of non‑red (non‑China) supply chains is rising. The three parties’ joint strengths will enhance supply‑chain competitiveness, using Taiwan as the starting point for cooperation and expanding further into Japan, the United States and Canada.

Chairman Lin Sheng‑ze said that as AI data centers demand more stable power and energy resilience, cross‑border technology collaboration will be a key to capturing market opportunities. The three‑way partnership, integrating each company’s core strengths in the energy sector, is expected to generate a synergy greater than the sum of its parts.

items.title: 台灣高鐵新列車首度正線測試達標 明年7月營運
items.title_en: Taiwan High‑Speed Rail’s New Train Passes First On‑track Test, Set for July Next Year Operation
paras: 台灣高鐵(2633-TW)新世代列車N700ST今(16)日凌晨首度在左營-嘉義路段進行正線測試，車行時速達170公里，完成階段性目標，首批新車預計明年7月1日正式投入營運。
台灣高鐵首組N700ST列車自8月15日運抵台灣，正逐步完成各項檢測，並於正線採階段提速方式依序完成時速40公里、70公里、120公里，最終達到時速170公里的預訂目標，後續相關測試工作持續按照計劃時程進行。
台灣高鐵本次共引進12組N700ST新世代列車，陸續運抵台灣，首批新車將於明年7月1日投入營運，預計12組新車將在2028年9月全數營運，屆時高鐵車隊規模擴增到46組列車，尖峰時段運能可提升25%。
台灣高鐵首組N700ST新世代列車上線前尚需通過69項安全和設備測試，作為新車型導入及驗證的基礎，包括特高壓測試、電池迴路、列車無線電、主電壓系統、駕駛控制系統、煞車系統、車載電腦及列車自動控制系統、車門系統、車重測量、車底設備系統、駕駛室輔助設備，以及廁所、空調系統等旅客服務設備。
paras_en: Taiwan High Speed Rail (2633‑TW) conducted the first on‑track test of its next‑generation N700ST train early this morning on the Zuoying‑Chiayi segment, reaching a speed of 170 km/h and meeting its phased target. The first batch of new trains is slated to enter service on July 1 next year.

The first N700ST set arrived in Taiwan on August 15 and is gradually completing various inspections. On the main line, it has been accelerated in stages, achieving speeds of 40 km/h, 70 km/h and 120 km/h, and finally reaching the planned 170 km/h. Subsequent testing will continue according to the scheduled timeline.

A total of 12 N700ST next‑generation trainsets are being introduced, arriving in Taiwan in phases. The first batch will commence operation on July 1 next year, and all 12 sets are expected to be fully in service by September 2028, expanding the fleet to 46 trainsets and boosting peak‑hour capacity by 25%.

Before the first N700ST trainset can go live, it must pass 69 safety and equipment tests that form the basis for introducing and validating the new model. These include ultra‑high‑voltage tests, battery circuits, train radio, main voltage system, driver control system, braking system, onboard computers and automatic train control, door system, weight measurement, under‑car equipment, cockpit auxiliary devices, as well as passenger‑service facilities such as toilets and air‑conditioning.

items.title: 資金寒冬來襲？WSJ：輝達緊縮AI企業金援　昔日「提款機」時代恐將成歷史
items.title_en: Funding Winter Coming? WSJ: Nvidia Tightens AI Corporate Funding; the Former "ATM" Era May Become History
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，辭去輝達執行長前幾個月，黃仁勳已開始調整支持AI經濟的方式。隨著長期對巨額交易謹慎的財務長柯蕾絲接掌，高度依賴輝達資金的AI新創公司預計融資將進一步收緊。這一轉向在上月柏林歐洲AI大會顯露無遺，多家靠採購輝達晶片出租算力的新興雲端公司執行長與會。黃仁勳演講時直言，輝達充當「無限提款機」的時代已告終，令部分與會者頗感意外。
《華爾街日報》(WSJ)報導，過去一年大多數時間裡，輝達陷入了瘋狂的交易狂潮：為新創公司提供財務擔保、動用自身的資產負債表為資料中心專案的債務融資提供支持，甚至充當自家晶片的「最後買家」。輝達甚至同意向部分客戶租用其晶片，以此向貸款方釋出訊號，證明這些客戶手中握有穩固合約。
今年稍早，輝達曾稱正準備推出新的財務激勵措施，並達成比以往任何時候都更多的交易，因為包括谷歌及超微在內的競爭對手，紛紛向這些公司提供類似的優惠，而黃仁勳不想因此失去市佔率。在這場攻勢中領軍的高層之一，便是輝達副總裁、同時也是黃仁勳女婿的Nico Caprez。
輝達7月對外宣布其融資計畫，但到了8月，黃仁勳與財務長柯蕾絲(Colette Kress)開始質疑部分交易的投資回報率。
當輝達動用其信用良好的資產負債表，協助OpenAI與軟銀旗下SB Energy在俄亥俄州派克頓簽下一筆龐大的資料中心租約時，該公司在8月的談判過程中縮減其承諾的規模，原因是柯蕾絲對這筆交易的規模產生了疑慮。
《WSJ》此前曾報導指出，黃仁勳在8月告知其財務團隊，輝達正承受壓力。他向他們表示，主要的雲端服務供應商正計畫改用替代性晶片，以降低對該公司的依賴；與此同時，輝達正面臨其已承諾購買的晶片晶圓與記憶體過剩的困境。黃仁勳也督促員工制定一套方法，以判斷這些擔保措施是否值得。輝達8月下旬暫停了該計畫中的部分交易。
英國新雲端(neocloud)業者Nscale，仍在與輝達及其他投資者進行談判，希望為其在西維吉尼亞州為Anthropic建造的一座耗資450億美元的資料中心提供財務後盾。
除廣泛擔保措施外，輝達還對AI新創公司進行了一系列股權投資。根據PitchBook數據，截至上周二(10日)，輝達今年共參與了創紀錄的129筆創投交易，佔全球創投交易總值的27%，遠高於2023年的49筆。
對於黃仁勳突然去職，已跟輝達達成交易的新創公司執行長們都鬆了一口氣，慶幸自己的交易在黃仁勳被解雇前順利過關。
一位知情人士透露，Perplexity的執行長Aravind Srinivas在10月30日於舊金山總部舉行的每週全員大會上，向員工分享了輝達已完成對該公司30億美元投資的消息。而就在前一天，外界剛曝出輝達爆發共諜案的消息。這家AI搜尋公司正以380億美元更高的估值，在這筆新投資入局前進行額外的資金募集。
其他公司的命運則懸而未決。知情人士透露，輝達最近向估值250億美元的開源模型開發商Reflection AI提出收購提案，打算授權其技術並挖角部分人才。黃仁勳曾公開讚揚過這家公司，但在黃仁勳離職前，雙方尚未達成協議。
此外，據知情人士透露，輝達一直在敲定對另一家開源模型供應商Thinking Machines Lab的巨額投資，對該公司的估值達400億美元。一位知情人士表示，Thinking Machines對這筆交易最終能夠完成充滿信心。Reflection和Thinking Machines每月都在燃燒巨額資金，用以支付開發其AI模型所需的運算能力，但尚未找到產生可觀營收的方法。
輝達近期投資的部分細節早前已由《金融時報》與科技媒體《The Information》披露。
一些營收極低甚至為零的公司創辦人及創投支持者表示，倘若輝達真的縮減未來的股權投資，他們恐怕將難以籌措資金來維持這些燒錢企業的營運，更遑論實現豐厚的「退場」。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that a few months before stepping down as CEO, Jensen Huang began adjusting how Nvidia supports the AI economy. With CFO Colette Kress, known for her caution on large‑scale deals, taking the reins, AI startups that heavily rely on Nvidia funding are expected to face tighter financing. This shift was evident at last month’s Berlin European AI Conference, where CEOs of several emerging cloud firms that lease Nvidia chips for compute attended. In his speech, Huang bluntly said the era of Nvidia acting as an "unlimited ATM" is over, a comment that surprised some attendees.

The Wall Street Journal reported that for most of the past year Nvidia was caught up in a frenzy of transactions: providing financial guarantees to startups, using its balance sheet to back debt financing for data‑center projects, and even acting as the "last buyer" of its own chips. Nvidia even agreed to lease its chips to certain customers to signal lenders that those customers held solid contracts.

Earlier this year Nvidia said it was preparing new financial incentive programs and would close more deals than ever before, because rivals such as Google and AMD were offering similar perks and Huang did not want to lose market share. One of the senior executives leading that push was Nvidia vice‑president and Huang’s son‑in‑law, Nico Caprez.
Nvidia announced its financing plan publicly in July, but by August Jensen Huang and CFO Colette Kress began questioning the return on investment of some of the deals.

When Nvidia used its strong balance sheet to help OpenAI and SoftBank’s SB Energy sign a massive data‑center lease in Parker, Ohio, the company scaled back its commitment during the August negotiations because Kress raised concerns about the size of the transaction.

The WSJ previously reported that in August Huang told his finance team that Nvidia was under pressure. He said major cloud providers were planning to switch to alternative chips to reduce dependence on Nvidia, while Nvidia faced a surplus of chip wafers and memory it had already pledged to buy. Huang also urged staff to devise a method to assess whether such guarantees were worthwhile. Nvidia paused several transactions in the program in late August.
British new‑cloud player Nscale is still negotiating with Nvidia and other investors, seeking financial backing for a $45 billion data center it is building in West Virginia for Anthropic.

Beyond broad guarantee programs, Nvidia has also made a series of equity investments in AI startups. According to PitchBook, as of last Tuesday (the 10th), Nvidia participated in a record 129 venture‑capital deals this year, accounting for 27% of global VC deal value, far above the 49 deals in 2023.
The CEOs of startups that had already struck deals with Nvidia breathed a sigh of relief after Huang’s sudden departure, glad that their transactions cleared before his exit.

An insider said Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas announced at the company‑wide town hall in San Francisco on Oct. 30 that Nvidia had completed a $3 billion investment in the firm. The announcement came a day after news broke of a major espionage scandal at Nvidia. The AI search company is now raising additional capital at a higher valuation of $38 billion before the new investment is finalized.

The fate of other companies remains uncertain. An insider disclosed that Nvidia recently made an acquisition proposal to open‑source model developer Reflection AI, valued at $25 billion, intending to license its technology and poach talent. Huang had publicly praised the firm, but no agreement was reached before his departure.

In addition, another insider said Nvidia is finalising a huge investment in open‑source model supplier Thinking Machines Lab, valuing the company at $40 billion. The source expressed confidence that the deal will eventually close. Both Reflection and Thinking Machines burn large sums each month to pay for the compute needed to develop their AI models, yet they have not found a way to generate substantial revenue.
Details of some of Nvidia’s recent investments were previously disclosed by the Financial Times and tech outlet The Information.

Founders and venture‑capital backers of companies with very low or zero revenue said that if Nvidia truly cuts back future equity investments, they will struggle to raise the cash needed to keep these cash‑burning businesses afloat, let alone achieve a lucrative exit.

items.title: 中化生前三季EPS 2.01元轉盈 持續深化原料藥與CDMO業務
items.title_en: China Chemical Bio Q1‑Q3 EPS Turns Positive to NT$2.01, Continues Deepening Specialty API and CDMO Business
paras: 中化生(1762-TW)公告財報，累計今年前三季稅後純益1.11億元，每股純益2.01元，較去年同期轉盈。中化生指出，將持續深化原料藥(Specialty API)及CDMO業務。
中化生第三季營收2.18億元，季減28.58%，年增41.11%；毛利率22.49%，季減15.42個百分點，較去年同移轉正；營益率-10.84%，較第二季轉負，營業虧損較去年同期縮小；稅後虧損2103.9萬元，較第二季轉虧，不過虧損較去年同期收斂，每股虧損0.38元。
中化生累計今年前三季營收8.84億元，年增27.9%；毛利率35.65%，年增24.01個百分點；營益率35.65%，較去年同期轉正；稅後純益1.11億元，較去年同期轉盈，每股純益2.01元。
中石化指出，過去1年積極調整產品組合、提升製造效率，聚焦具備技術門檻與市場競爭力產品，加快特色原料藥商業化進程。同時，透過與BioDuro成立合資公司，推進歐洲大型藥廠的新藥CDMO專案。
展望明年，中化生表示，隨著特色原料藥新品逐步商業化，並深化國際CDMO合作，將加速擴大高附加價值業務營收貢獻，目標明年營收成長雙位數。
paras_en: China Chemical Bio (1762‑TW) announced its financial results, reporting a cumulative net profit after tax of NT$111 million for the first three quarters of this year, equating to earnings per share of NT$2.01, a turnaround from a loss in the same period last year. The company said it will continue to deepen its specialty API and CDMO businesses.

In the third quarter, China Chemical Bio posted revenue of NT$218 million, down 28.58% quarter‑over‑quarter but up 41.11% year‑over‑year; gross margin was 22.49%, a decline of 15.42 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter, turning positive compared with the same quarter last year; operating margin was –10.84%, shifting negative from the second quarter, while operating loss narrowed versus the same quarter last year; after‑tax loss was NT$21.039 million, a loss compared with the second quarter, but the loss narrowed relative to last year, amounting to a loss per share of NT$0.38.

Cumulatively for the first three quarters, revenue reached NT$884 million, a 27.9% increase year‑over‑year; gross margin was 35.65%, up 24.01 percentage points year‑over‑year; operating margin was 35.65%, turning positive versus the same period last year; net profit after tax was NT$111 million, a swing to profit from last year, with earnings per share of NT$2.01.

Sinopec noted that over the past year it has actively adjusted its product mix and improved manufacturing efficiency, focusing on products with technical barriers and market competitiveness, and accelerating the commercialization of specialty APIs. At the same time, through a joint venture with BioDuro, it is advancing new‑drug CDMO projects for large European pharmaceutical companies.

Looking ahead to next year, China Chemical Bio said that as new specialty API products are gradually commercialized and international CDMO collaborations are deepened, it will accelerate the growth of high‑value‑added business revenue, targeting double‑digit revenue growth next year.

items.title: 上市櫃超過150檔個股跌停 法人：市場關注輝達AI循環融資發展
items.title_en: Over 150 Listed Stocks Hit Limit Down; Institutions Watch Nvidia AI Cycle Financing Development
paras: 台股今(16)日盤中越走越低，加權指數跌點一度超過2200點，跌幅超過4.5%，櫃買指數跌幅更超過6%，合計上市櫃多達150檔亮跌停燈，市場氣氛延續上周五美股黑色星期五的恐慌拋售。
台積電今日盤中重挫達4%，造成跌點約830點，主要因外資沿路減碼，後續先觀察美國 ADR 走勢，而目前市場聚焦11月17日輝達公布財報，此為首場沒有黃仁勳的法說，統一投顧分析，將由代理執行長兼財務長柯蕾絲(Colette Kress)主持，儘管市場預期營收上看 1090 億美元、年增約 90%，但投資人聚焦核心已轉向黃仁勳離職後的領導真空、高達數千億美元的「AI 循環融資」與信用擔保是否收縮。
高市值個股有南亞(1303-TW)、台光電(2383-TW)、欣興(3037-TW)、奇鋐(3017-TW)、創意(3443-TW)、智邦(2345-TW)和大立光(3008-TW)、南電(8046-TW)、景碩(3189-TW)、台燿(6274-TW)和台玻(1802-TW)等均跌停。
元大投顧認為，日前大盤年線發揮超級抵抗，並出現大 V 型反彈，惟走法太過凌厲，幾乎未經過整理，籌碼不穩定，預期指數接下來將會在年線39212點與季線46165點間區間來回。
同時還需留意，將有 AI 獨角獸 Anthropic 掛牌定價。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks fell increasingly today (the 16th), with the weighted index dropping over 2,200 points at one point and falling more than 4.5%, while the OTC index slipped over 6%. A total of more than 150 listed stocks lit up the limit‑down signal, and market sentiment continued the panic sell‑off that followed last Friday’s Black Friday in the U.S. markets.

TSMC plunged about 4% intraday, wiping roughly 830 points, mainly because foreign investors trimmed positions and then watched the U.S. ADR trend. The market is now focused on Nvidia’s earnings release on November 17, the first without Jensen Huang. Unified Investment & Securities analysis says the briefing will be led by acting CEO and CFO Colette Kress. Although revenue is expected to reach $109 billion, up about 90% year‑over‑year, investors’ attention has shifted to the leadership vacuum after Huang’s departure, the multi‑hundred‑billion‑dollar ‘AI cycle financing’ and whether credit guarantees will tighten.

High‑market‑cap stocks such as Nanya (1303‑TW), Taiwan Optoelectronics (2383‑TW), Unimicron (3037‑TW), Qihong (3017‑TW), Creative (3443‑TW), Chipbond (2345‑TW), Largan Precision (3008‑TW), Nan Dian (8046‑TW), Jing Shuo (3189‑TW), Tai Yao (6274‑TW) and Taiwan Glass (1802‑TW) all hit limit‑down.

Yuanta Investment & Securities believes the market index recently showed strong resistance at the yearly line and produced a big V‑shaped rebound, but the move was too sharp, with almost no consolidation and unstable capital, expecting the index to oscillate between the yearly line at 39,212 points and the quarterly line at 46,165 points.
Also need to watch the upcoming listing price of AI unicorn Anthropic.

items.title: AI下一棒誰接？國泰投信攜手大和國泰證券揭台韓半導體新商機
items.title_en: Who Will Take the Next AI Baton? Cathay Investment Trust Partners with Daiwa Cathay Securities to Reveal New Taiwan‑Korea Semiconductor Opportunities
paras: AI投資熱潮持續延燒，從HBM、先進製程到AI代理與實體AI（Physical AI），科技產業的成長機會正從晶片延伸至整體供應鏈！國泰投信11/4攜手大和國泰證券及鉅亨網，於「臺灣週」舉辦「從矽谷到矽島：AI時代的投資地圖」論壇，邀集日本大和證券、韓國科技產業專家及國泰投信研究團隊，剖析全球記憶體供需、台灣半導體升級與台韓科技市場，並帶領投資人透過國泰臺韓科技（證券代號：00735）、主動國泰動能高息（基金之配息來源可能為收益平準金且並無保證收益及配息）（證券代號：00400A）等投資工具，參與AI產業下一階段的成長機會。
本次論壇由國泰投信投資長鄭立誠、日本大和證券專務執行董事鈴木直樹，以及大和國泰證券總經理光田岳史共同揭開序幕，並邀請大和韓國科技產業專家Sung Kyu Kim、國泰投信臺韓科技專家李翰林、台股半導體專家黃秋文及國泰投信基金經理人梁恩溢接力分享，從國際產業研究延伸至實際投資策略。
█ 不只算力，更需要記憶體！韓國記憶體迎新成長週期

大和韓國科技產業專家Sung Kyu Kim指出，AI發展正從模型訓練延伸至推論、代理型AI及物理AI，記憶體已成為影響系統效能的重要環節。隨著AI晶片持續升級，HBM容量與傳輸頻寬需求同步提升；未來AI代理需要處理更長的對話脈絡、執行更複雜的任務，也將進一步推升DRAM與NAND需求。四大科技巨頭微軟、亞馬遜、Meta及Google持續擴大AI資本支出，三星預期記憶體供應緊張延續至2028年，SK海力士的DRAM與HBM產能需求能見度更延伸至2029年。

儘管需求強勁，供給端的擴張速度卻未必跟得上。國泰投信臺韓科技專家李翰林表示，隨著晶片製程微縮逐漸逼近物理極限，摩爾定律放緩，DRAM製程升級難度提高，HBM及NAND高層數堆疊亦增加製造複雜度與擴產成本，使記憶體供需緊俏格局有望延續。韓國在記憶體產業具有領先優勢，台灣則掌握先進製程、先進封裝及AI伺服器供應鏈，兩地科技產業形成高度互補；國泰臺韓科技ETF（證券代號：00735）同時布局台韓科技企業，讓投資人透過一檔ETF，參與兩地半導體產業的成長機會。
█ AI下一棒從晶片走向整體系統　先進封裝、光通訊接力
國泰投信台股半導體專家黃秋文表示，隨著AI從資料中心走向終端應用，產業需求正由GPU擴展至CPU、記憶體、通訊及電力系統，帶動台灣供應鏈持續升級。其中，先進封裝需求隨著GPU與ASIC升級而持續擴張，台積電積極增加CoWoS產能，也帶動封測設備、IC載板、廠務工程及材料等相關產業的成長機會。

黃秋文指出，除了先進製程與封裝，光通訊及電力系統也成為新成長領域。隨著AI運算叢集規模擴張，資料傳輸速度朝800G、1.6T升級，CPO等技術受到關注；AI機櫃功耗增加，也推動供電架構朝高壓直流發展。然而，產業具備成長前景，不代表所有企業都能同等受惠，未來關鍵在於規格升級能否帶動產品價值提升，以及企業是否具備技術門檻與量產能力，將需求轉化為實際獲利。隨著AI商機從少數科技龍頭擴散至更多供應鏈環節，如何辨識真正具備競爭優勢的企業，也成為投資布局的重要課題。
█ AI受惠名單持續輪動　00400A搭配國泰台灣高股息攻守兼備
對於AI產業下一階段的投資策略，00400A與國泰台灣高股息基金（本基金並無保證收益及配息）經理人的梁恩溢表示，AI長期趨勢未變，但受惠企業並非一成不變。從晶片、伺服器到先進封裝、光通訊及電源管理，產業成長動能持續轉移，投資人除了尋找產業下一棒，也應思考如何在參與成長的同時，兼顧投資組合的收益需求與風險管理。

梁恩溢指出，面對AI產業快速輪動，投資布局可採取「一攻一守」的搭配策略。以00400A作為進攻部位，結合動能與高息雙軌選股，從超過1,900家上市櫃公司出發，透過基本面、成長動能及股息條件篩選，精選約40至60檔股票，並由經理人依產業趨勢靈活調整配置，尋找具備成長潛力的企業；國泰台灣高股息基金（本基金並無保證收益及配息）則作為防守部位，以高股息股票為配置核心，透過「選體質、選位置、選評價」三重選股法，重視企業獲利品質、股利紀錄及評價合理性，著眼長期投資價值。
國泰投信表示，從韓國記憶體到台灣先進製程與AI供應鏈，科技產業的成長機會正持續擴散。投資人可透過00735參與台韓科技產業發展，並依自身投資目標與風險承受能力，搭配00400A與國泰台灣高股息基金（本基金並無保證收益及配息），以「動能抓成長、高息選體質」的攻守配置思維，參與AI產業長期發展機會。

paras_en: The AI investment boom continues to blaze, expanding from HBM and advanced processes to AI agents and Physical AI. Growth opportunities in the tech sector are stretching from chips to the entire supply chain! On November 4, Cathay Investment Trust teamed up with Daiwa Cathay Securities and Business Weekly to host the “From Silicon Valley to Silicon Island: Investment Map for the AI Era” forum during Taiwan Week, gathering experts from Daiwa Securities Japan, Korea’s tech industry, and Cathay’s research team to dissect global memory supply‑demand, Taiwan’s semiconductor upgrades, and the Taiwan‑Korea tech markets, and to guide investors to participate in the next phase of AI growth through tools such as the Cathay Taiwan‑Korea Technology ETF (ticker: 00735) and the Active Cathay Momentum High‑Yield fund (ticker: 00400A).

The forum was opened by Cathay Investment Trust’s Chief Investment Officer Cheng Li‑cheng, Daiwa Securities Japan’s Executive Director Naoki Suzuki, and Daiwa Cathay Securities General Manager Takashi Mitsuta, followed by a panel featuring Daiwa Korea tech expert Sung Kyu Kim, Cathay Taiwan‑Korea tech specialist Li Han‑lin, Taiwan semiconductor analyst Huang Chiu‑wen, and Cathay fund manager Liang En‑yi, who shared insights from global industry research to concrete investment strategies.
Not just compute power – memory is essential! Korean memory enters a new growth cycle.

Korean tech expert Sung Kyu Kim noted that AI is moving from model training to inference, agent‑type AI and Physical AI, making memory a critical factor for system performance. As AI chips evolve, demand for higher‑capacity HBM and wider bandwidth rises; future AI agents will need to handle longer conversational contexts and more complex tasks, further boosting DRAM and NAND demand. The four tech giants—Microsoft, Amazon, Meta and Google—are expanding AI capex, Samsung expects memory tightness to last through 2028, and SK Hynix sees DRAM and HBM capacity visibility extending to 2029.

Even with strong demand, supply expansion may lag. Cathay Taiwan‑Korea tech specialist Li Han‑lin explained that as chip nodes approach physical limits, Moore’s Law slows, DRAM process upgrades become harder, and higher‑stack HBM and NAND increase manufacturing complexity and cost, likely keeping memory supply tight. Korea holds a leading edge in memory, while Taiwan commands advanced processes, advanced packaging and AI server supply chains; the two regions complement each other. The Cathay Taiwan‑Korea Technology ETF (00735) invests in both markets, allowing investors to capture semiconductor growth across the two ecosystems with a single ETF.
AI’s next baton shifts from chips to whole systems—advanced packaging and optical communications take the lead.

Cathay Taiwan semiconductor analyst Huang Chiu‑wen said that as AI moves from data centers to edge applications, demand expands from GPUs to CPUs, memory, networking and power systems, driving continuous upgrades in Taiwan’s supply chain. Advanced packaging demand grows alongside GPU and ASIC upgrades; TSMC is aggressively expanding CoWoS capacity, which in turn fuels growth for test‑and‑pack equipment, IC substrates, fab services and related materials.

Huang added that beyond advanced processes and packaging, optical communications and power systems are emerging growth areas. As AI compute clusters scale, data‑transfer speeds are moving toward 800 Gbps and 1.6 Tbps, drawing attention to CPO and similar technologies; higher power draw in AI racks pushes power‑delivery architectures toward high‑voltage DC. However, not every company will benefit equally—future success hinges on whether specification upgrades translate into higher product value and whether firms possess the technical barriers and mass‑production capability to turn demand into profit. As AI opportunities spread from a few tech giants to broader supply‑chain participants, identifying truly competitive companies becomes a key investment task.
The AI beneficiary list keeps rotating—00400A paired with Cathay Taiwan High‑Dividend for balanced offense and defense.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉光通訊遍地慘綠超過10檔亮燈跌停 台股仍待消化輝達利空
items.title_en: Focus Stocks: Optical Communication Stocks Plummet Over 10 Tickers Hit Limit Down, Taiwan Market Still Digesting Nvidia Bad News
paras: 台股今(16)日受美國科技股賣壓沉重，主要權值AI概念股回檔拖累大盤，市場解讀，台股為仍待消化輝達(NVDA-US)前執行長黃仁勳，個人去職大利空，加上台幣重貶接近33元，今日盤中一度重挫超過2,200點，盤面上高價科技股、AI相關指標全面走跌。包括光通訊龍頭股聯亞(3081-TW)也難倖免於難，今開低走低，亮燈跌破2,000元大關，其他光通訊供應鏈更是一片慘綠，包括輝達背板股的波若威(3163-TW)超過10檔一度觸及跌停。
台股今日開低走低，其中網通設備、光通訊族群遭遇狙擊強烈賣壓，類股大跌超過8.5%，光通訊族群中近年漲幅較大的CPO概念股，今日也承受賣壓遭下殺。
包括聯亞、光聖(6442-TW)、波若威、前鼎(4908-TW)、上詮(3363-TW)、華星光(4979-TW)、光環(3234-TW)、眾達-KY(4977-TW)、統新(6426-TW)、環宇-KY(4991-TW)、IET-KY(4971-TW)也超過10檔以上盤中紛紛重挫觸及跌停價。
其他包括聯鈞、東典光電跌幅也超過8.5%以上。
法人表示，光通訊今(2026)年漲幅過大，這波下殺顯示短線獲利盤與融資維持率壓力大舉出籠，導致多頭資金出現恐慌性撤離，建議投資人先觀察大盤氣氛與法人賣超是否收斂。
法人指出，投資人可靜待高融資個股完成融資斷頭與籌碼沉澱，先觀察大盤鈞線能否守穩，作為後續進場布局的參考依據。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market fell heavily today (the 16th) under pressure from US tech stocks, with major AI‑related index stocks pulling the market down. The market interprets this as Taiwan still needing to absorb the negative impact of Nvidia (NVDA‑US) former CEO Jensen Huang's personal departure, compounded by the New Taiwan dollar weakening to near NT$33. At one point the index plunged more than 2,200 points intraday, and high‑priced tech and AI‑related indicators all fell. Even the optical‑communication leader Lian Ya (3081‑TW) could not escape, opening lower and sliding below the NT$2,000 mark, while other optical‑communication suppliers were drenched in red, with more than ten stocks, including Nvidia back‑plane supplier Bo Ruo Wei (3163‑TW), briefly hitting their daily limit down.

The market opened lower and continued to fall, with networking equipment and optical‑communication groups hit by strong selling pressure, dragging the sector down more than 8.5%. Within the optical‑communication group, CPO‑related stocks that have surged in recent years also faced heavy selling today.

Companies such as Lian Ya, Guang Sheng (6442‑TW), Bo Ruo Wei, Qian Ding (4908‑TW), Shang Quan (3363‑TW), Hua Xing Guang (4979‑TW), Guang Huan (3234‑TW), Zhong Da‑KY (4977‑TW), Tong Xin (6426‑TW), Huan Yu‑KY (4991‑TW) and IET‑KY (4971‑TW) all saw more than ten stocks each plunge sharply and hit their limit‑down prices during the session.
Other stocks including Lian Jun and Dong Dian Optoelectronics also fell by more than 8.5%.

Institutional investors said that optical‑communication stocks have risen excessively this year (2026), and this wave of selling shows short‑term profit‑taking and high margin‑maintenance pressure forcing a panic exit of bullish capital. They advise investors to first watch the overall market sentiment and whether institutional net‑selling is easing.

Institutions also noted that investors can wait for highly‑leveraged stocks to complete margin calls and for share‑holding consolidation, while monitoring whether the market’s key support line holds, using that as a reference for future entry strategies.

items.title: 熙特爾與美國GE Vernova、韓國SK On簽署MOU 瞄準AI基建商機
items.title_en: Xiteler Signs MOU with US GE Vernova and South Korea SK On to Target AI Infrastructure Opportunities
paras: 熙特爾(7740-TW)今(16)日宣布，與美國能源設備大廠GE Vernova、韓國SK集團旗下電池製造商SK On簽署合作備忘錄(MOU)，建立台美韓戰略合作關係，三方將結合電力轉換技術、先進電池技術與大型儲能系統整合製造能力，共同布局國際能源市場，瞄準全球AI電力基礎建設商機。
熙特爾指出，此次合作將結合三方各自優勢，GE Vernova提供高功率電力轉換設備(PCS)，可望簡化系統配置、減少能源損耗並降低建置成本，提升大型儲能系統的運作效率與經濟效益；SK On提供磷酸鐵鋰(LFP)電芯與模組，藉由長循環壽命與電池技術，滿足大型儲能系統對長期可靠性的需求。
而熙特爾旗下辰熙精密(AUROSI)則負責在地化整合製造，將美韓兩大國際企業的核心技術，轉化為完整儲能解決方案。
熙特爾指出，隨著美國、日本等主要持續強化資安與供應鏈韌性需求，非紅供應鏈的重要性的提升。此次三方攜手結合優勢，強化供應鏈競爭力，並以台灣為合作起點，進一步拓展至日本、美國與加拿大等市場。
董事長林聖澤表示，隨著AI資料中心對穩定供電與能源韌性的要求提高，跨國技術合作將成為掌握市場商機的重要關鍵。此次三方攜手，整合各自在能源領域的核心優勢，有望發揮一加一加一大於三的綜效。
paras_en: Xiteler (7740‑TW) announced today (the 16th) that it has signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with US energy‑equipment giant GE Vernova and South Korean battery maker SK On, a subsidiary of the SK Group, establishing a Taiwan‑US‑Korea strategic partnership. The three parties will combine power‑conversion technology, advanced battery technology and large‑scale energy‑storage system integration capabilities to jointly pursue the international energy market and target global AI power‑infrastructure opportunities.

Xiteler said the cooperation will leverage each partner’s strengths: GE Vernova will provide high‑power power‑conversion equipment (PCS), which is expected to simplify system configuration, reduce energy loss and lower construction costs, thereby improving the operational efficiency and economic benefits of large‑scale storage systems; SK On will supply lithium‑iron‑phosphate (LFP) cells and modules, whose long cycle life and battery technology meet the long‑term reliability needs of large‑scale storage systems.

Xiteler’s subsidiary Chenxi Precision (AUROSI) will handle localized integration and manufacturing, turning the core technologies of the two major international firms into complete energy‑storage solutions.

Xiteler noted that as the United States, Japan and other major economies continue to strengthen cybersecurity and supply‑chain resilience requirements, the importance of non‑red (non‑China) supply chains is rising. The three parties’ joint strengths will enhance supply‑chain competitiveness, using Taiwan as the starting point for cooperation and expanding further into Japan, the United States and Canada.

Chairman Lin Sheng‑ze said that as AI data centers demand more stable power and energy resilience, cross‑border technology collaboration will be a key to capturing market opportunities. The three‑way partnership, integrating each company’s core strengths in the energy sector, is expected to generate a synergy greater than the sum of its parts.

items.title: 台灣高鐵新列車首度正線測試達標 明年7月營運
items.title_en: Taiwan High‑Speed Rail’s New Train Passes First On‑track Test, Set for July Next Year Operation
paras: 台灣高鐵(2633-TW)新世代列車N700ST今(16)日凌晨首度在左營-嘉義路段進行正線測試，車行時速達170公里，完成階段性目標，首批新車預計明年7月1日正式投入營運。
台灣高鐵首組N700ST列車自8月15日運抵台灣，正逐步完成各項檢測，並於正線採階段提速方式依序完成時速40公里、70公里、120公里，最終達到時速170公里的預訂目標，後續相關測試工作持續按照計劃時程進行。
台灣高鐵本次共引進12組N700ST新世代列車，陸續運抵台灣，首批新車將於明年7月1日投入營運，預計12組新車將在2028年9月全數營運，屆時高鐵車隊規模擴增到46組列車，尖峰時段運能可提升25%。
台灣高鐵首組N700ST新世代列車上線前尚需通過69項安全和設備測試，作為新車型導入及驗證的基礎，包括特高壓測試、電池迴路、列車無線電、主電壓系統、駕駛控制系統、煞車系統、車載電腦及列車自動控制系統、車門系統、車重測量、車底設備系統、駕駛室輔助設備，以及廁所、空調系統等旅客服務設備。
paras_en: Taiwan High Speed Rail (2633‑TW) conducted the first on‑track test of its next‑generation N700ST train early this morning on the Zuoying‑Chiayi segment, reaching a speed of 170 km/h and meeting its phased target. The first batch of new trains is slated to enter service on July 1 next year.

The first N700ST set arrived in Taiwan on August 15 and is gradually completing various inspections. On the main line, it has been accelerated in stages, achieving speeds of 40 km/h, 70 km/h and 120 km/h, and finally reaching the planned 170 km/h. Subsequent testing will continue according to the scheduled timeline.

A total of 12 N700ST next‑generation trainsets are being introduced, arriving in Taiwan in phases. The first batch will commence operation on July 1 next year, and all 12 sets are expected to be fully in service by September 2028, expanding the fleet to 46 trainsets and boosting peak‑hour capacity by 25%.

Before the first N700ST trainset can go live, it must pass 69 safety and equipment tests that form the basis for introducing and validating the new model. These include ultra‑high‑voltage tests, battery circuits, train radio, main voltage system, driver control system, braking system, onboard computers and automatic train control, door system, weight measurement, under‑car equipment, cockpit auxiliary devices, as well as passenger‑service facilities such as toilets and air‑conditioning.

items.title: 〈楊金龍立院備詢〉穩守匯市「不是嘴巴說說 是實彈喔」 曝升息列為選項
items.title_en: Yang Jin‑long Testifies in Legislature: “We’ll Guard the FX Market – Not Just Words, Real Action,” Hints at Possible Rate Hike
paras: 中央銀行今(16)日在立院備詢時表示，儘管出口高度熱絡，但外資從台股賺到的錢和領到股利後匯出，較出口商拋匯的力道還大，才會導致新台幣走弱，再次呼籲市場，強調央行調節「不是只是嘴巴講講，是實彈喔」，另外，更釋出可能升息的風向，表態距離第四季理監事會議尚有一個月時間，足夠讓央行評估「要不要升息」。
楊金龍認為，外資投資賺錢匯出很正常，但央行對外匯市場抱持的柳樹理論不是讓它拼命擺，是適度搖擺，因此，「央行並非只是嘴巴講講，調節是實彈喔」。
楊金龍進一步表態，儘管短期新台幣看起來貶幅大，但長期來看貶幅較日元和韓元整體仍有限。
央行12月18日將召開第四季央行理監事會議，市場高度關注是否開始跟進美國聯準會的升息腳步，楊金龍說「從現在到下個月中旬這段期間，有足夠時間讓央行評估要不要升息」。
楊金龍提到，這次央行是否升息主要看三個指標，第一是目前通膨、明年的通膨預測，第二是其他國家的升息情況，第三為金融市場的放款情況和經濟熱不熱絡。
paras_en: The central bank told legislators today (the 16th) that although exports are booming, the amount foreign investors repatriate after earning profits and dividends on Taiwanese stocks exceeds the foreign‑exchange selling pressure from exporters, which is why the New Taiwan dollar has weakened. It reiterated to the market that the bank’s interventions are “not just talk, they are real actions,” and also signaled that a rate hike remains on the table, noting there is about a month before the fourth‑quarter board meeting, giving the bank enough time to assess whether to raise rates.

Yang Jin‑long said it is normal for foreign investors to send home earnings, but the central bank’s “willow‑tree” approach to the FX market is not to fight it aggressively but to sway it moderately, so “the bank’s actions are not just words, they are real actions.”
He added that although the New Taiwan dollar may appear to depreciate sharply in the short term, its long‑term decline relative to the Japanese yen and South Korean won is still limited overall.

The central bank will hold its fourth‑quarter board meeting on December 18, and markets are closely watching whether it will follow the U.S. Federal Reserve’s rate‑hike path. Yang Jin‑long said “there is ample time from now until mid‑next month for the bank to evaluate whether a rate hike is needed.”

He noted that the decision on a rate hike will hinge on three indicators: current inflation and next‑year inflation forecasts, the rate‑hike actions of other countries, and the state of credit‑extension in financial markets and overall economic activity.
